# Self-Attention from Scratch

> Every token looks at every token.

**Type:** Build
**Languages:** Python, TypeScript
**Prerequisites:** Phase 1, Lessons 01-02, Phase 1 · Calculus
**Time:** ~90 minutes

## Key Terms

| Term | What people say | What it actually means |
|------|-----------------|------------------------|
| Attention | "Focus" | Weighted average of values. |
| Softmax | "Normaliser" | See math. |
| P(token \| context) | "Conditional" | Probability with an escaped pipe. |

## Further Reading

- [Attention Is All You Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762) — the paper.
